outcome: Survival to neonatal intensive care unit discharge
Grade 3 or 4 periventricular hemorrhage (PVH) or periventricular leukomalacia (PVL)
Treated retinopathy of prematurity among survivors
cohort: Infants born at 22 to 23 weeks' gestation from January 1, 2015, through December 31, 2021, without major congenital anomalies, who were admitted for neonatal intensive care in 11 national or regional neonatal consortia across 12 countries or regions.
finding: Substantial international variations were identified in survival and major morbidities for infants born at 22 to 23 weeks' gestation across 11 neonatal networks in 12 countries or regions.
country: 12 countries or regions through 11 international neonatal networks
followup_time: To neonatal intensive care unit discharge
